more_info.uses: EU permissions include other confectionery including breath freshening micro-sweets. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA had insufficient evidence for a food-use risk assessment in 2016.
Poor solubility suggests limited systemic exposure, but the lack of toxicity studies prevents a firm conclusion about higher doses.
more_info.overview: Gold is classified in food technology as a color. Its technological role is to add or restore colour.
